# awx_notification_template_webhook (Data Source)

Reads an AWX `Webhook` (`webhook`) notification template by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Database ID of this notification template.
- `name` (String) Name of this notification template.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description of this notification template.
- `disable_ssl_verification` (Boolean) Verify SSL. AWX defaults this to "false" when unset.
- `headers` (Map of String) HTTP Headers. AWX requires this key; the provider sends an empty map when unset.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP Method. AWX defaults this to "POST" when unset.
- `messages` (String) Optional custom messages for this notification template, as a JSON object.
- `notification_type` (String) AWX notification type, fixed by this resource.
- `organization` (Number) Organization this notification template belongs to.
- `url` (String) Target URL.
- `username` (String) Username.
